newsitem.title: USA: ADR REPORT - U.S. ADRs trail broader market.
newsitem.headline: ADR REPORT - U.S. ADRs trail broader market.

text.p: Foreign shares trailed the broader New York market on Monday with little news to boost them, traders said.

Although the Dow Jones Industrial Average was higher on momentum from Friday's record close, most American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) have moved up only slightly in the last few days, said one analyst.
"You would think that with the market's performance of the last couple of days it would be up higher," he said.
Among ADRs, France's Alcatel Alsthom rose by midday to 14-5/8, up 3/8, on news it had submitted a bid for France's state-run electronics and defense group Thomson SA.
Argentine bottler Buenos Aires Embotelladora SA, or BAESA, was among leading stocks in terms of percentage gains, rising 5/8, or 8.33 percent, to 8-1/8.
Traders attributed the rise to short-covering by traders as the stock recovered from a year's low of 4-1/2. "Certainly there is no news that is moving it up," one said.
Analysts also said BAESA might have been helped by optimism that the Argentine Congress would approve a fiscal package on Wednesday after delaying a vote last week.

French chemicals group Rhone-Poulenc SA was up following Paris brokerage Cholet Dupont's upgrade of the company from accumulate to buy. Rhone-Poulenc's ADRs were trading at 27-1/4, up 3/4, in early afternoon.
Brazilian state telecommunications company Telebras also rose a point to 79-1/4, reflecting the upward trend of the wider market.
